codex_contract.preserved_semantics: Fan out N parallel workers, drain them, and return one report. Use for /swarm, 'swarm this', or parallel coverage, races, gauntlets, and exploration.

native_mapping.fallback: A dropped or unavailable worker is recorded as BLOCKED; the aggregate is partial when required coverage is missing. Never silently drop a worker.

permission_gates: Open a four-phase todolist (Frame, Fan out, Aggregate, Report) before launching workers.
Declare the done predicate, output, shape, total N, selection rule for races, worker models, and separate writable outputs before fan-out.
Launch all N bounded workers in parallel; use local execution only when they need access to the user's computer. Sequential fallback is not fan-out proof.
Require each worker to report PASS, ISSUES, or BLOCKED with evidence. Preserve dropouts and mark the aggregate partial when required coverage is missing.
Respect the current task scope, selected model/effort, repository ownership, and explicit approval requirements.

behavioral_proof.positive: A four-phase todolist precedes one parallel N-worker launch; each worker returns PASS, ISSUES, or BLOCKED with evidence; the coordinator drains and aggregates one report.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: An unavailable worker is recorded as BLOCKED and the aggregate explicitly identifies uncovered slices or a partial race.
behavioral_proof.error: Malformed input or failed worker is reported with its slice and evidence; the aggregate does not claim full coverage or widen scope.

upstream_readme.note: Verified in the pinned upstream clone; the README is referenced for provenance and is not vendored in this skills-only snapshot.

security_review.decision: Keep the source finding and provenance; do not dismiss it because the adapter adds a warning.

## Codex adaptation

Before launch, open a four-phase todolist: Frame, Fan out, Aggregate, Report. State the done predicate and output; choose partition, race, or mixed shape; declare the selection rule for a race; set total N, worker models, and separate writable outputs. Launch all N bounded native workers in parallel. Use local workers only when they need access to the user's computer. Each brief stands alone and requires PASS, ISSUES, or BLOCKED with evidence. Drain terminal results and return one compact aggregate with every required slice, issues, and explicit gaps or dropouts. A sequential fallback is not fan-out proof. This candidate remains unindexed until the stated behavior and permission proof exists.
